newsitem.title: USA: California panel OKs $170 mln for flood control.
newsitem.headline: California panel OKs $170 mln for flood control.

text.p: A California legislative committee approved a bill that would appropriate $170 million from the state budget to fund flood control projects, state officials said on Thursday.

The state Assembly Water, Parks and Wildlife Committee voted unanimously to approve Assembly Bill 97 by Republican Assemblymembers Peter Frusetta and Jim Morrissey. The bill now advances to the Assembly Appropriations Committee, the lawmakers said in a statement.
The measure will appropriate $170 million from the state budget to fund the final construction of 19 flood control projects throughout the state.
"Our bill holds the state to its word when it pledged matching funds to property owners and local governments throughout California," Frusetta said.
